patch_description: The prior best program (score 0.90, sum 2.37) used a hexagonal lattice constructor with exact LP radii plus a slack-directed hill climb within a ~1.2s time budget. The current program dropped the climb and regressed slightly. I restore the climb and strengthen it: (1) broader candidate pool of staggered row patterns (5×4×5×4×5×3, 4×5×4×5×4×4, 7-row variants, and a 3-4-5-6-5-4... middle-heavy variant), all evaluated with exact LP radii; (2) a time-budgeted (~1.6s) slack-directed hill climb that picks the circle with the largest deficit (weighted toward tight circles), moves 70% along its direction of maximum slack and 30% randomly, with adaptive step size (grow 1.15 on acceptance up to 0.05, shrink 0.92 down to 0.002); (3) LP re-solves use precomputed pair-distance matrices for speed. Key parameters: step=0.02 initial, deadline 1.6s, slack weighting exponent, climb acceptance threshold 1e-9.
